title.zh: 账号管理补齐、上游模型同步与更新预览
title.en: Account controls, upstream model sync and update previews

zh: 在线更新页面新增“预览更新内容”入口，可在弹窗中查看目标版本的功能变化、修复记录和对应提交，更新后仍可查看当前版本记录。
账号管理新增上游模型拉取，支持新建 API Key 账号预览和已保存账号同步，自动去重模型白名单并保留已有映射。使用代理或自定义请求头时需先保存账号。
账号表单按基础信息、连接凭据、模型请求、分组调度、额度重置和高级设置分区，改善桌面与手机端的排版。
账号列表补齐运行状态、调度评分与上游费率展示，支持服务端排序、行内调整优先级和恢复代理设置。
补充计费分组预览与同步、请求头身份变量校验、Ollama 云用量会话和平台模型预设等账号配置。
修复极低用量和未知额度的显示问题，补全模型配置、额度校验及中英文文案。
en: Added an update preview dialog showing the target frontend version’s feature changes, fixes and source commit. Installed update history remains available after updating.

Fetch upstream models when previewing a new API key account or syncing a saved account. Model whitelist entries are deduplicated and existing mappings are preserved. Save accounts using proxies or custom headers before syncing.
Reorganized account forms into basic information, connection credentials, model requests, group scheduling, quota resets and advanced settings, with improved desktop and mobile layouts.
Expanded account lists with operational status, scheduler scores and upstream rates, server-side sorting, inline priority editing and proxy setting recovery.
Added billing group previews and synchronization, request header identity variable validation, Ollama cloud usage sessions and platform model presets.
Fixed very low usage and unknown quota displays, and completed model configuration, quota validation and Chinese and English copy.

title.zh: 前端在线更新与注册、密钥体验改进
title.en: Frontend updates, registration and API key improvements

zh: 新增管理员前端在线更新，可在更新设置中检查并安装界面更新，查看构建进度与失败日志。
新增前端发行说明，在检查更新时展示对应提交的中英文改动记录。
修复启用邮箱验证后无法完成注册的问题，并正确显示验证码重发倒计时。
修复主机刚启动时版本检查可能延迟的问题，首次检查即可获取最新版本信息。
修复创建密钥时桌面端厂商图标与文字挤压的问题，并在手机端使用下拉选择以适应窄屏。
en: Administrators can now check for and install frontend updates from update settings, with build progress and failure logs available.
Added frontend release notes with Chinese and English changes for the checked commit.
Fixed registration failures when email verification is enabled and corrected the countdown for resending verification codes.
Fixed delayed version checks immediately after host startup so the first check can retrieve the latest version information.
Fixed cramped provider icons and text in the API key creation dialog on desktop and added a dropdown selector for narrow mobile screens.
